I do agree with a lot of this.  Saving avatars would be nice.  So long as the person allows them to be publicly saved.  (I have avatars that are very personal to me, as they are my own characters, of my own design.  I heard someone took it from the cache and went around using my own characters... but never seen personally)
2.  Tags would be nice, something to add perhaps to the SDK for upload.
3. Re-downloading only happens if you visit a lot of worlds, as it saves to your cache, as long as it's not updated, it won't re-download.
4. Would be nice to have 3rd person, but at least we have mirrors.
5. I've been able to select people through the social menu,  and found the report feature.  I've had to use it a few times because some people move around too much, and I blocked them.

don't worry about the English, I was able to understand you perfectly!.
Closing due to age, please make a new post if it is still relevant.

thank you for vrchat. it's so funny and enjoyable i like to spend time in it. i don't have VR machine just keyboard, mouse, mice, headset, monitor. anyway im sure you guys taking this feedback but i want to write it because im not so great pc expert and avatars too much important for me.


    1-Rightclick and save avatar

    2-Search something in avatars like whenever creator made something s/he will add the tags when i search a tag simple like "spider-man" i will see the all avatar rooms includes spider-man models.

    3-After long time i play the game whenever login same "world" i have to re-download it again it's really hard me i live in Turkey we have really low internet bandwith speed with expensive price like 4MB or 8MB. I really want to download my favorite worlds to my pc. I would be so happy if you guys add "Favorite Worlds"

    4- Third Person option ( i know sounds silly because that's not purpose of VR i'm aware of that.) would be nice.

    5-In anyworld social section doesn't have report this user button. Some people keep saying N word on the steam description developers mention about "We actively monitor VRChat and have a no tolerance policy with regards to harassment in any form. We will take action including permanent account termination. Refer to our community guidelines for more information." this so i want to report that guy next time.( i can't click people if they have really small little avatars!)


    i'm sorry for my bad english. i'm trying to communicate with peoples saying "hello" in their language. i'm requesting this humbly. Atleast for avatars because too much computer science for casual users many people don't know how to do it we just switching worlds.
title: my humble requests from developers
